basis.governing_question: How can [Client] create a foothold in the digital space through a marketplace without major cannibalization or short-term loss?

phases.name: Design
phases.objective_one_line: Answer the key questions on the marketplace and agree a blueprint for the pilot

gate.label: Go/no-go on pilot
gate.decision: Do we launch the pilot on this blueprint?

phases.name: Pilot
phases.objective_one_line: Build a first version and launch it with a small group of users, then test and iterate

gate.label: Go/no-go on beta
gate.decision: Do we launch the local beta phase on this business case?

workstreams.name: Scope & hypotheses
workstreams.answers: Which questions must the blueprint answer?
activities: Set hypotheses on each blueprint component

workstreams.name: Analyze
workstreams.answers: Which hypotheses hold for customers and the market?
activities: Test hypotheses with a wireframe prototype

workstreams.name: Plan
workstreams.answers: What does the pilot need to start?
activities: Plan the pilot phase in detail

deliverables.name: Detailed plan for the pilot phase

workstreams.name: Enable
workstreams.answers: Who and what does the venture need inside the parent?
activities: Identify and onboard key internal hires

deliverables.name: Strategic KPIs agreed with key stakeholders

workstreams.name: Validate
workstreams.answers: Which customers do we launch with?
activities: Identify the first customer target group

workstreams.name: Build
workstreams.answers: Does a first version work with real users?
activities: Launch to a small group of users and iterate

deliverables.name: First version launched to a small user group

workstreams.name: Plan scale-up
workstreams.answers: What would launching the local beta take?
activities: Draft the implementation plan and roadmap

deliverables.name: Business case with implementation plan and roadmap

events.label: Kick-off
events.purpose: Align on scope, plan and team
agenda: Align on the governing question and scope
Confirm the plan and interview list

events.label: Mid-phase check-in
events.decision: Are the hypotheses the right ones to test?

events.label: Go/no-go on pilot
events.purpose: Decide whether to start the pilot
events.decision: Do we launch the pilot on this blueprint?

events.label: Workshop 1: first findings
events.decision: Are we aligned on the solution hypotheses and direction?
agenda: Present first findings from both phases
Align on where the big questions remain

events.label: Workshop 2: key questions
events.decision: Do we confirm the solution, positioning and business model view?
agenda: Discuss the enablement plan and incentives

events.label: Go/no-go on beta
events.purpose: Decide on the local beta phase
events.decision: Do we launch the local beta phase on this business case?
agenda: Present the implementation plan and investment case

architect_notes: Engagement type and the 24-week length are the firm's own proposal; every phase and week count rests on them.
